summary: The St. Joe Company filed an 8-K disclosing a $150.8 million increase in its share repurchase authorization, bringing total capacity to $200.0 million under the existing Stock Repurchase Program with no expiration date. The company had $49.2 million remaining prior to the expansion. This is an issuer-initiated capital return via open-market buybacks, not a tender offer. There is no stated price, premium, or timeline. The board authorized the additional repurchase capacity as a discretionary use of corporate cash. Investors should watch actual repurchase execution pace and any impact on diluted share count or earnings per share.
